- Incubator (50–80°C)
- pH meter and buffer solutions

- Centrifuge
- Microcentrifuge tubes
- Spectrophotometer
- Chromatography columns (ion exchange or affinity)
- UV-Vis spectrophotometer
- Protective gear (lab coat, gloves, goggles, face shield)
